name: ChatGPT
knownFor: The default consumer chatbot and the widest public entry point to OpenAI’s models, with a free tier plus paid Plus and Pro plans.
popCaption: 55.7% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Largest public web traffic of any assistant in the Similarweb set
con: Paid-plan limits and model names change often; the $200–$500 Pro tiers are easy to overbuy
costCaption: Typical plan: Plus $20/month (OpenAI Help, “What is ChatGPT Plus?”, checked Nov 2026).

name: Gemini
knownFor: Google’s assistant, available as a standalone app and inside Search, Android, and Google Workspace.
popCaption: 24.2% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Second-largest web-traffic share, and it sits inside Search and Android
con: Website-visit figures under-count use that happens inside Search or the Gemini app
costCaption: Typical plan: Google AI Pro $19.99/month (one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans and gemini.google/subscriptions, checked Nov 2026).

name: Claude
knownFor: A writing- and work-oriented assistant with Claude Code included on paid plans, plus a free web app.
popCaption: 11.5% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Fastest-growing of the large assistants in that Similarweb web-traffic set
con: Still far behind ChatGPT and Gemini on website visits; paid usage limits still apply
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro $20/month, or $17/month billed annually (claude.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: DeepSeek
knownFor: A Chinese lab whose models lead public OpenRouter token usage, with a free consumer chat app and a separate API.
popCaption: 3.4% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Leads public OpenRouter token volume, which is a real API-side signal
con: Consumer-site traffic is much smaller than ChatGPT or Gemini; OpenRouter is not the same as consumer-app use
costCaption: The consumer chat app is presented as free (deepseek.com, checked Nov 2026).

name: Grok
knownFor: xAI’s assistant, with live web and 𝕏 search, image and video generation, and a paid X Subscription ladder shared with Cursor.
popCaption: 2.2% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Built-in live search and image/video tools in one thread
con: Website-visit share is still small; the paid ladder is bundled with Cursor, which can confuse a simple seat price
costCaption: Typical plan: Premium $30/month, labeled most popular (x.ai/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Same X Subscription ladder as Cursor (shared usage pool; cursor.com/pricing).

name: Microsoft Copilot
knownFor: Microsoft’s assistant, available on the web and inside Windows and Microsoft 365. Consumer paid access is sold as Microsoft 365 Premium.
popCaption: 1.1% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Sits where many office workers already are
con: Standalone-site traffic looks small because most use is in-product
costCaption: Typical plan: Microsoft 365 Premium $19.99/month (microsoft.com copilot pricing for individuals, checked Nov 2026).

name: Meta AI
knownFor: Meta’s assistant, built into Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and a standalone meta.ai site.
popCaption: 43.9M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Distribution inside WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook is hard to ignore
con: No comparable public website-visit share was found, so the star rating is editorial
costCaption: The consumer Meta AI app is free to use (meta.ai, checked Nov 2026).

name: Qwen
knownFor: Alibaba’s Qwen models and Qwen Chat, widely used in China and available as open weights and an API.
popCaption: 35.1M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Strong open-weight family and a real API footprint
con: No comparable Similarweb website-visit share was found for the consumer app
costCaption: The consumer Qwen chat app is free to use (chat.qwen.ai, checked Nov 2026).

name: Kimi
knownFor: Moonshot’s Kimi assistant, known for long-context work, with models that show up clearly on OpenRouter.
popCaption: 19.6M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
con: OpenRouter share is not the same as consumer-app popularity
costCaption: The consumer Kimi chat app is free to use (kimi.com, checked Nov 2026).

name: Z.ai (GLM)
knownFor: The consumer and API home of the GLM models, which have a large footprint on OpenRouter.
popCaption: 9.2M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool). GLM models also rank near the top of OpenRouter’s mid-November 2026 token leaderboard · checked Nov 2026
learn: Low-cost API and open GLM models
pro: High public API token volume on OpenRouter
con: Consumer-app traffic was not found in the Similarweb seven-site set
costCaption: The consumer Z.ai chat app is free to use (chat.z.ai, checked Nov 2026).

name: Mistral Le Chat
knownFor: Mistral’s consumer assistant (Le Chat) and the Mistral Pro plan, from a European open-weight lab.
popCaption: 8.0M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026; mistral.ai company site, which includes Le Chat and other Mistral pages) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Clear public individual price and open-weight options
con: Much smaller public usage signal than the traffic leaders in this research pass
costCaption: Typical plan: Le Chat Pro $14.99/month (mistral.ai/pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: Character.AI
knownFor: A consumer chat app built around character and role-play conversations rather than a single general assistant.
popCaption: 154.2M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
pro: A distinct consumer audience that general assistants do not fully replace
con: No current official price or visit-share figure was captured this session
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $$ band. No public individual price captured this session · checked Nov 2026
